Title: GA: Azure Red Hat OpenShift support for OpenShift 4.5

Body.Content:
Azure Red Hat OpenShift support for OpenShift release 4.5 is now generally available. OpenShift release 4.5 includes several new features, enhancements, and updates to the OpenShift web console.

Learn more about OpenShift 4.5.

Learn more about the ARO release schedule.
